lints.title: Leaked Password Protection Disabled
lints.description: Leaked password protection is currently disabled.

findings.detail: Supabase Auth prevents the use of compromised passwords by checking against HaveIBeenPwned.org. Enable this feature to enhance security.

interpretation.tracker_members: RLS with no direct policy is intentional deny-by-default; callers use a narrow auth.uid()-scoped membership predicate. It exposes no member roster.
interpretation.anonymousPredicate: is_tracker_member has no caller-supplied user ID and only returns whether auth.uid() belongs; null/other identities do not gain owner access.
interpretation.authenticatedRpcWarnings: Existing guarded RPCs are intentionally callable, with per-user/member checks and tested narrow grants. These warnings are retained, not a clean-advisor claim.
interpretation.passwordProtection: Leaked-password protection remains disabled, as previously reported. No Auth configuration or paid plan was changed.

limits: SQL-role rollback checks do not prove signed-JWT HTTP behavior; that test still requires real second-user credentials.
